title: Physics Informed Neural Networks for Solving the Drift-Diffusion Equations
abstract: arXiv:2610.33133v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The drift-diffusion equations are the fundamental building block for the modeling, design, and optimization of modern semiconductor devices. Solutions of the drift-diffusion equations rarely give way to analytical forms, and exhibit strong nonlinearity, with the solutions ranging over several orders of magnitude. These attributes have led to research into numerical solvers, and while many commercial Technology Computer Aided Design (TCAD) packages now exist, they may require long simulation times, exhibit sensitivity to initial guesses, and rely on mesh generation. Further, these solvers are not well suited for inverse problems where the design parameters of a device are retrieved from its desired functional characteristics. translated_title: 用于求解漂移-扩散方程的物理信息神经网络
translated_abstract: 漂移-扩散方程是现代半导体器件建模、设计和优化的基本构建模块。漂移-扩散方程的解很少能以解析形式给出，并且表现出强非线性，其解的取值范围跨越多个数量级。这些特性促使了对数值求解器的研究，虽然目前已有许多商用技术计算机辅助设计（TCAD）软件包，但它们可能需要较长的仿真时间、对初始猜测敏感，并且依赖于网格生成。此外，这些求解器并不适合于从器件的期望功能特性中反推其设计参数的逆问题。为了应对所有这些挑战，本工作展示了使用物理信息神经网络（PINNs）来求解漂移-扩散方程，其误差与传统仿真软件相当。
tldr: 本文提出使用物理信息神经网络（PINNs）求解半导体器件的漂移-扩散方程，其精度与传统仿真软件相当，同时克服了网格生成、长仿真时间和逆问题求解等传统方法的局限。
en_tdlr: This work demonstrates the use of Physics Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) to solve the drift-diffusion equations with errors comparable to traditional simulation software, while overcoming limitations such as mesh generation, long simulation times, and inverse problem solving.
